{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check how many patients were re-tested (each appears twice)
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
retested_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1].count()
print("Number of re-tested patients:", retested_patients)

# Confirm the highest sample_seq per patient is kept
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify number of rows after deduplication
print("Rows after deduplication:", len(df_dedup))

# Also verify that -999 rows are excluded from any analysis involving baseline
# But we'll do that in the next step when computing response rates

# Print final shape
print("Final shape after deduplication:", df_dedup.shape)"}
